semanticHistory.text:
**Track D Findings**
- `x-claude-code-session-id` is captured by the proxy before any JSONL dependency. `mitmAddon.py` allowlists it, lowercases headers, and writes it into request events: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/mitmAddon.py:70`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/mitmAddon.py:179`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/mitmAddon.py:426`.
- The proxy can observe the header, but current code does not promote it. `ProxyServer` polls `proxy-events.jsonl` and emits parsed raw events: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/proxyServer.ts:312`, then `ClaudeSession` forwards them only into `headless.handleProxyTransportEvent`: `src/providers/claude/runtime/claudeSession.ts:409`.
- `ClaudeProxyAdapter` receives request headers only as attribution-policy input, then discards them from flow state. Default attribution checks only `/v1/messages` and host, not the session header: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/ClaudeProxyAdapter.ts:192`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/ClaudeProxyAdapter.ts:220`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/ClaudeProxyAdapter.ts:662`.
- No existing semantic/screen/committed event includes provider session identity. Semantic event types cover turn/block/flow diagnostics, not session headers: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/channels/SemanticChannel.ts:96`; screen is visual-only: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/channels/ScreenChannel.ts:13`; committed is JSONL-only: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/channels/CommittedChannel.ts:16`.

**Main/Renderer Path**
- Main forwards `semantic-event` and coalesced `jsonl-entry` separately; there is no raw proxy/header IPC: `src/main/sessions/forwarder.ts:39`, `src/main/sessions/forwarder.ts:61`.
- Renderer captures Claude `providerSessionId` only from JSONL entry `sessionId` fields in the bulk JSONL handler: `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:996`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:1006`.
- If JSONL is absent, fresh runtime still starts with `transcriptStatus: 'ready'`, `totalEntries: 0`, and `lastJsonlEntryAt: null`: `src/renderer/src/workspace/workspaceState.ts:566`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/workspaceState.ts:609`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/workspaceState.ts:624`.
- Semantic can continue rendering independently: IPC folds semantic events into `runtime.semantic`, phase, ghosts, unread state, and feed-debug: `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:663`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:775`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:854`.
- When semantic completes without JSONL, renderer archives bounded semantic history (`20`) and log (`200`) but does not persist provider identity: `src/renderer/src/workspace/semantic/helpers.ts:22`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/semantic/foldEvent.ts:871`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/semantic/foldEvent.ts:982`.

**Retention**
- Full proxy logs live under `~/.config/agent-code/proxy/<project>/<session>/<run>/proxy-events.jsonl`: `src/main/storage/paths.ts:41`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/proxyServer.ts:489`.
- Debug bundle reader picks the latest matching run by `proxy-events.jsonl` mtime and includes only a 5 MiB tail when oversized: `src/main/storage/proxyEventsReader.ts:72`, `src/main/storage/proxyEventsReader.ts:111`, `src/main/storage/proxyEventsReader.ts:199`.
- If the expected session segment is missing, bundle lookup scans all session dirs and may intentionally return a nearby/wrong log instead of none: `src/main/storage/proxyEventsReader.ts:137`.
- Retention treats proxy captures as cache: default TTL 48h, budget 10-15 GiB total, proxy gets 28%, active grace 10 min, and pruning deletes whole run dirs while skipping `_shared-conf`: `src/main/storage/debugRetention.ts:21`, `src/main/storage/debugRetention.ts:187`, `src/main/storage/debugRetention.ts:344`, `src/main/storage/debugRetention.ts:405`.

**Recommendations**
- Add a first-class `provider_session_observed` event at the proxy boundary when a request has `headers['x-claude-code-session-id']`; include `{ providerSessionId, flowId, source: 'proxy-header', observedAt, cwd/sessionKey }`.
- Emit it from `ClaudeSession` or `ClaudeCodeHeadless` before the adapter drops headers, then forward through `SessionManager`/IPC so renderer can persist a provisional `providerSessionId` with provenance.
- Add a “semantic active but JSONL absent” watchdog: if proxy semantic events or `stream_phase !== idle` occur and `lastJsonlEntryAt === null` after N seconds, mark transcript disconnected instead of `ready`.
- Log expected transcript path alongside the proxy header in debug bundles: cwd project dir, `<providerSessionId>.jsonl` existence, size, mtime, and subagent dir existence.
- Add a reconciliation invariant: proxy-header id may seed durable identity, but history should be marked reloadable only after the root JSONL path exists or the loader confirms an alternate layout.
